mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_close_step (id, period_close_id, step_no, step_type, status, result_hash, completed_time, create_time, update_time) VALUES (#{row.id}, #{row.periodCloseId}, #{row.stepNo}, #{row.stepType}, #{row.status}, #{row.resultHash}, #{row.completedTime}, #{row.createTime}, #{row.updateTime})
mapper.select: SELECT id, period_close_id, step_no, step_type, status, result_hash, completed_time, create_time, update_time FROM t_close_step WHERE period_close_id = #{periodCloseId} ORDER BY step_no
mapper.update: UPDATE t_close_step SET status = #{status}, result_hash = #{resultHash}, completed_time = #{now}, update_time = #{now} WHERE id = #{step.id} AND status = #{step.status}
